def replace_params(path: str, param_convertors: dict[str, Convertor[typing.Any]], path_params: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
    remaining_params = dict(path_params)
    
    def replace_func(match: typing.Match[str]) -> str:
        param_name = match.group(1)
        if param_name in param_convertors:
            value = remaining_params.pop(param_name, None)
            if value is None:
                raise AssertionError(f"Missing required path parameter: {param_name}")
            convertor = param_convertors[param_name]
            # Validate the value using the convertor
            if not convertor.regex or not re.match(f"^{convertor.regex}$", str(value)):
                raise AssertionError(f"Invalid value for path parameter '{param_name}': {value}")
            return str(value)
        return match.group(0)
    
    formatted_path = PARAM_REGEX.sub(replace_func, path)
    return formatted_path, remaining_params
